depiction_rules.notes: Form a protective canopy above Vasudeva and infant Krishna during the storm. The posture must feel sheltering and reverent, never predatory.

visual_bible.body: large ivory-white serpent body with restrained deep-blue patterning
visual_bible.hoods: an odd-numbered fan of many symmetrical cobra hoods, centered over the child
visual_bible.jewels: small warm gemstones on the hoods casting gentle path-light
visual_bible.movement: smooth protective arc through storm and river spray

never: do not obscure the faces of Vasudeva or Krishna
note: Use the reference for story placement only; generate an original temple-mural interpretation.
